scope: Used-source literal aggregate extraction and consistency checks only; no rate fitting, uncertainty simulation or clinical activation
chronology: Published outcomes and Table 2 were inspected before this plan; this is an analysis plan recorded before automated extraction, not preregistration or independent validation

source.cache_disposition: fetch_only; ignored research documentation; source article not redistributed

selection.table_caption: Death rates (per 1,000 person-years) before and after the onset of diabetes
selection.selected_columns: Only literal death-count/person-year pairs; published rates and age-standardized rates are not selected or recomputed
selection.counts_and_exposure: Published integer death counts and whole person-years; preserve displayed precision
selection.time_semantics: Updated age; time before recorded diagnosis or duration since recorded diagnosis, not biological onset or full current glycemic state
selection.crosschecks: Compare selected cells with all-age row totals and age-column total rows; compare Table 1 denominators with reported total followed cohort and total deaths; retain narrative incident-diabetes discrepancy
selection.failure_policy: Raise on corrupted source/schema/extraction; return observed failed consistency checks without changing source values or tolerances

uncertainty: No sampling distribution is imposed. Repeated person-time and clinic assignment are preserved; no independent Poisson/binomial draws, confidence intervals or joint covariance are invented.
limits: Baseline IGT does not guarantee persistent IGT before diagnosis; current glycemic reversion is not observed here
Dates after the original trial depend mainly on clinical diagnoses rather than systematic scheduled OGTTs
Displayed person-years are rounded aggregates, not individual clocks or complete linked histories
Intervention groups are pooled in this mortality analysis; it does not isolate diet-only assignment
Time-dependent association is not a causal effect of changing diabetes state
Incomplete follow-up and baseline-only confounder adjustment do not establish ignorable selection or transport to the U.S.
